svg.title: Preferences transfer in clusters: Qwen2.5 city distribution distillation
svg.desc: The schematic shows a teacher city preference passing through a probability distribution over complete two-digit strings 00–99 to a separately trained student. Below are all 30 measured city nodes at the published PCA coordinates, without jitter. The 86 directed arrows and 27 self-loops show double-centered, question-averaged log-probability changes of at least 4 nats. An arrow points from teacher city to student answer city; stroke width is proportional to the centered value. Positive centered values are relative interactions, not necessarily absolute probability increases. Negative and weaker values are omitted; this display cutoff is not a significance test. Colors identify six predefined geographic groups, not inferred clusters. Six city labels are shown for readability. PCA uses the full signed 30-by-30 matrix. Measured data source: data/figures/figure2.json, panel qwen25_city_number_distribution, in PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer; file SHA256 731e14b0ba8d2712b8bbd5973676de2f968c726f394f298f18dae0b776879f42. Original source matrix SHA256 342512af9c932cc61c3457c8789ec94f4e61ce7baf73f620f3116afe7ab330a5.
svg.title: City preferences transfer in clusters
